svg.title: AI-native delivery
svg.desc: Spec-driven development pipeline: a spec and a plan feed an orchestrator that fans work out to analysis, code, test and documentation agents, followed by human review and a CI/CD release. MCP servers, RAG, agent Skills and repository memory ground the agents. Pillars: Specify, Spec-driven development: the spec is the source of truth agents work from. Orchestrate, Multi-agent workflows that split analysis, code, tests and docs. Ground, MCP servers and RAG give agents real project context. Verify, Tests, CI and human review before anything ships. Tools: Claude, OpenAI, LangChain, n8n, Ollama, Copilot, MCP.
